notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.80

• DuckWallet adds a card the way Apple's Wallet does: hold it up to the camera and its number, expiry and name are read off it, with the card's own colours, or tap "Enter Card Details Manually". Then Card Details, the expiry and security code, "Adding Card…" and "Card Added", where you can pick how the card looks.
• "Cards Found For You": cards from your other devices (through DuckCloud) wait there until you add them to this phone.
• Create a Pass: make your own pass for a membership, a ticket or anything with a barcode. Scan its barcode or QR code with the camera or take it from a photo, and pick a colour. Gift cards and store cards scan their barcodes with the camera too.
• DuckPay: its "+" opens DuckWallet's new card adding, the card shows on its own once you're recognised (the note under it is gone), and cards keep the colours DuckWallet gave them.
